48 docs/cyrus/05-bridge-and-accounts.md
# 05 Bridge and accounts

How a Nxeon customer becomes a Cyrus user, how money and plans move, and how Cyrus touches a customer's game server. State: **built and tested on node-2 with fakes and real Test Flight servers; nothing deployed; every switch OFF** (see [reference/flags-and-env.md](reference/flags-and-env.md), launch order in [07 operations](07-operations.md)).

## Today (inside Nxeon) vs the target
Today Cyrus uses Nxeon's sign-in, wallet, Stripe and game-server install path directly (through the host seam, [01 architecture](01-architecture.md)). The target (defaults from the full plan, 2026-10-11): **Nxeon is the identity provider and the only money system; Cyrus sells nothing itself**; per-server scoped grants, never SSH credentials; a separate Cyrus Postgres; Cyrus has its own admin; separate Cyrus Terms/Privacy (lawyer-reviewed before public launch). These are the working defaults agents r37-r40 built to (the owner was asked to confirm them in the full plan and has not objected); the open exceptions are in [12 gaps and roadmap](12-gaps-and-roadmap.md).

## SSO and identity (r36)
One app serves both hosts. `lib/cyrus/bridge/{config,routing}.ts` + middleware: cyrus.my gets the Cyrus brand bar around the same `/dashboard/cyrus` pages; the customer-app tree is exposed as `/home`, `/new`, `/account`, `/projects[/<id>]`; portal pages hand off to Nxeon; everything else 404s. **Sign in with Nxeon** = redirect with an Ed25519 signed assertion (state/nonce bound to the starting browser, single-use jti, exact `redirect_uri`, 120 s), a stable **subject id (Nxeon user id; never email)**, verified email required, a separate Cyrus cookie parented to the Nxeon session; **Sign in with Cyrus** on Nxeon lands on the same account; sign-up goes through Nxeon `/register` behind a consent screen; impersonation never crosses hosts; logout is a signed hop both ways. Keys: `CYRUS_BRIDGE_*` (secrets, env only). Routes under `/cyrus-host/*` (sign-in, sign-up, auth start/callback/handoff/logout).
Verified: two-origin e2e 46/46 with the mode on and 6/6 off (no studio on cyrus.my, no IdP, internal tree 404, spoofed marker ignored); own-flow security review (open redirect, login CSRF, replay, forged subject, header spoofing, impersonation leak, fixation, consent/logout CSRF). Not run: `next build`, a real browser, staging behind nginx.

## Wallet, tokens and plans
- **Unit and sources**: see [00 overview](00-overview.md). 1 token = $0.002 of measured AI cost (`cyrus_tok_tokens_per_usd=500`), Yakko x1.25, min 5 per build. Game-server purchase grants `clamp(round5(100 + 16 x monthly $), 150, 750)`; each paid renewal `clamp(round5(25 + 6 x monthly $), 40, 300)` (only for games Cyrus builds for); lots expire after 90 days; plans Katara $4.99 = 750/month, Saka $19.99 = 3,500, All models $49.99 = 10,000, stacking, each month's tokens last 3 months; top-ups $5-$100 at 120 tokens/$, 12-month expiry. Placeholder amounts for the r41 "free tokens with deploys and renewals" copy are pending the owner.
- **Ledger**: append-only, idempotent (`idemKey` UNIQUE), reserve -> settle -> release per build; tables `CyrusTokenAccount/Lot/Ledger/Reservation`, `CyrusPlan`; the only writer is `lib/cyrus/tokens/ledger.ts`. Our-side failures are free (3 per rolling 7 days). Daily caps (5,000 tokens; 1,000 for accounts under 7 days). Sweep every 5 minutes.
- **Stripe**: plan prices found by lookup key `cyrus_plan_<tier>_v1` (`scripts/cyrus-tokens-stripe-setup.ts`, TEST mode; refuses a live key without an explicit override). Cyrus checkout sessions carry `cyrusUserId`, never the Nxeon user id, so Nxeon's wallet engine can never treat them as a top-up (pinned by a test).
- **Starter grant**: ONE free build (`cyrus_tok_starter=70`), with a guard against split launch flags.
- **Launch pair**: `cyrus_studio_public_enabled` and `cyrus_tok_live` must move TOGETHER (a public studio without the economy builds for free; the economy without the studio sells nothing). `lib/cyrus/launch-state.ts` refuses a split pair; the admin Flags tab flips both with a typed confirm.
- **Purchases from either host (r36)**: card checkouts return to the host they started on; wallet top-ups (`CYRUS_WALLET_PAY`) are idempotent by reference with a compensating refund and pending/failed states; signed purchase webhooks (`CYRUS_PURCHASE_EVENTS*`) credit tokens once; refunds and chargebacks reverse unspent tokens once (`CYRUS_CHARGEBACK_REVERSAL`). Gap: no wallet button in the tokens modal (API only), and card purchases credit directly rather than through the event path.

## Entitlement sync (r38)
Plans and tokens are Nxeon products; `GET /api/platform/cyrus/v1/entitlements` plus a signed `entitlement.changed` event feed Cyrus's **mirror** (`CYRUS_ENTITLEMENT_MIRROR`, 60 s cache, `CYRUS_ENTITLEMENT_MAX_AGE_H`), **fail closed** when unknown; reconciliation job; refunds/chargebacks reverse once; a partner-attribution hook (`CYRUS_PARTNER_ATTRIBUTION`) computes a proposal only (whether the Creator Partner Program 50%/10% applies to Cyrus plans is an open decision).

## Plan limits in the entitlement (D-63/D-64, additive)
Nxeon's entitlement (`GET /entitlements`, `entitlement.changed`) carries an optional `limits: { games, storageGb }` for the entitled tier (Free when no plan; `games` 0 = unlimited), read from Cyrus' settings (`nxeonEntitlementSources.limits`). It is informational: Cyrus enforces game slots and storage from its own config; the mirror's parser accepts it (bounded integers) and an older receiver ignores it. Contract regenerated (`tools/nxeon-platform/gen-openapi.ts`).

## Storage add-on (r51)
Extra storage is a monthly Nxeon product (`cyrus.storage.addon`), switch `CYRUS_STORAGE_ADDONS` (needs `CYRUS_STORAGE`), code `lib/cyrus/storage/addon.ts`. **Price**: the owner's per-GB bands (1 GB $0.85, 5 GB $0.75, 25 GB $0.60, 50 GB $0.30, 100 GB $0.20) in setting `cyrus_storage_price_table`; rule `cyrus_storage_pricing_rule` = `capped` (default, an ASSUMPTION pending the owner: cost(n) = min(rate(n) x n, min over higher breakpoints b of rate(b) x b), so fewer GB never cost more; 20-50 GB all cost $15.00, 67-100 GB $20.00), `literal` (the cliff: 49 GB $29.40 > 50 GB $15.00) or `graduated`. Placeholders until confirmed (OWNER-ACTIONS "r51").
- **Wallet** (default): reference `cst:<user>:g<gb>:<key>` is the wallet reference AND the idemKey (`CyrusStorageCharge.idemKey` UNIQUE), so the direct apply, the signed purchase webhook (envelope `kind: "storage"`, same receiver `/api/cyrus/purchase-events`), a redelivery, the wallet reconcile (`reconcileStorageCharges`) and the entitlement mirror apply a charge once. A failed apply after the charge refunds the wallet (compensating `:refund`).
- **Changes**: increase = the price difference for the rest of the period, charged now (rounded up); decrease or cancel = at the period end (never a mid-period refund). **Renewal**: the storage sweep charges the wallet once per period (`renew_<periodEnd ms>` key), retries a failed renewal daily for 7 days (status `past_due`, quota back to the plan's), then cancels. **Refund** of the charge in force takes its GB back. A quota drop starts a 30-day grace; nothing is deleted.
- **Card**: a Stripe subscription on Nxeon's account with an inline monthly price (`openStorageCheckout`, embedded checkout, return `/api/cyrus/storage/return`); `invoice.paid` / `customer.subscription.*` / `charge.refunded` for storage subscriptions are handled BEFORE the plan handler so a storage subscription is never mirrored as a plan. Built, **not run against Stripe**; GB changes on a card add-on = cancel and buy again.
- **Entitlement sync**: Nxeon's snapshot carries an optional `storage` array (wallet `cst:` charges with refunds; absent when empty, so older receivers see the same shape); the Cyrus mirror applies any it has not (`applyMirroredStorageCharge`) and refuses another account's reference.
- Tests: `test/cyrus-storage-db.test.ts` (8, throwaway Postgres: buy once on retry, prorated increase, decrease at renewal, renewal once, cancel -> lapse + grace, refund reverses once, insufficient funds, event/mirror/reconcile once), `test/cyrus-storage-addon.test.ts`, `test/cyrus-storage-pricing.test.ts` (prints the price table).

## Platform API and per-server grants (r38)
- **Connect Cyrus** consent screen `/dashboard/connect/cyrus`: a user ticks which servers Cyrus may act on. 7 scopes (servers.read, inventory.read, files.write.mods, server.reload, server.restart (budgeted), logs.read.tail, pack.set), revocable any time; every call tied to user + server + grant; stores memory + SQL (`CYRUS_SERVER_GRANTS`, `CYRUS_SERVER_GRANTS_STORE`; SQL proposal `prisma/manual-migration-cyrus-bridge-grants.sql`, not applied).
- **Platform API v1** `/api/platform/cyrus/v1/*` (served by Nxeon, `CYRUS_PLATFORM_API`): servers, inventory (incl. Mods-tab records), file primitives (allow-listed paths, 64 MiB caps, sha preconditions), reload, budgeted restart, log tail, pack.set; HMAC service key (`CYRUS_PLATFORM_KEYS`) + Cyrus-signed Ed25519 user assertion + grant per call; rate limits, idempotency, audit; a **rollback-only window after revoke**. Cyrus consumes it via `createHttpHost({ platform })` and the delivery orchestrator runs over the primitives. Contract: [reference/openapi.md](reference/openapi.md).
- **Events Nxeon -> Cyrus** (`CYRUS_PLATFORM_EVENTS*`, signed outbox, change watcher): `server.version_changed` (marks mods outdated), `server.deleted` (revokes grants), `server.restarted`, `grant.created/updated/revoked`. **Events Cyrus -> Nxeon** (API v1 webhooks): `build.finished`, `mod.published`, `install.result`, `delivery.rolledback` (all four emitters wired in r38); outbox with retries 1 m, 5 m, 30 m, 2 h, 12 h, then dead letter (kept for replay).
- **UX**: "Create a mod for this server" button (`CYRUS_SERVER_BUTTON`) prefilling game, version, loader; pre-install conflict report (Mods-tab duplicates block) in the install modal.
- Verified: DB tests 12/12 on a throwaway DB; two-service e2e 5/5 (fresh install, revoke mid-install, revoke mid-update, broken worldgen rollback with 2 budgeted restarts, no/read-only grant); a **real node-2 run** delivered through 120 API calls and booted a real Paper 1.21.11 Test Flight (passed) and restored exact bytes after a revoke mid-update (the first run found and fixed a rollback bug). Not done: no real Nxeon server touched; memory stores per process; `library.contributed` unemitted; card top-ups not in the entitlement snapshot.

## Cyrus API v1 (direction B)
Versioned, token-authenticated API for Nxeon or any trusted site (`CYRUS_API_V1`, off = 404; bad config = 503, never "no auth"): service tokens `cyk_<id>_<secret>` (only sha256 stored, scopes, per-key rpm), **Ed25519 subject assertions** (Cyrus holds only the public key; `iss`=client, `aud`, 120 s, single-use jti, email refused), identity-clients rule (`CYRUS_API_V1_IDENTITY_CLIENTS`, default `nxeon`; r32 AC-1), idempotency keys and `CyrusApiIdempotency`, errors/pagination/versioning per [../api/CYRUS-API-PLAN.md](../api/CYRUS-API-PLAN.md). Operations (live vs planned): [reference/openapi.md](reference/openapi.md). r44 adds personal API keys (`cyk_...`) accepted by v1. Nxeon-side client: `lib/cyrus-client`.

## Webhooks and domain mode
Webhooks Cyrus -> Nxeon: `CYRUS_API_V1_WEBHOOKS` + `_URL` + a dedicated `_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (24+ chars, never `AUTH_SECRET`); nothing in product code emits them until the flags are on, except the four emitters r38 wired. Domain mode and hosts: `CYRUS_DOMAIN_MODE`, `CYRUS_HOSTS`, `CYRUS_ORIGIN`; cyrus.my/app/admin/api subdomain DNS and nginx are owner actions (runbook).

## Gaps (honest)
Nxeon does not yet serve the host API in production; write endpoints not exercised over real HTTP across machines; no collector for telemetry; SQL outbox dispatcher and conversion sender not built; attribution receiver on nxeon.cloud not built; Kodely identity policy and networking mods in packs are owner decisions. Move-day plan: [CYRUS-MOVE-RUNBOOK.md](../CYRUS-MOVE-RUNBOOK.md).
